# Asendify

> Asendify is a UAE-based YouTube growth agency founded by Manthan Bhendkar. It offers retention-engineered video editing, YouTube channel growth, AI automations and web design for creators, finance channels and investment firms (VC, PE, investment banking).

## Services
- [YouTube Growth & Video Editing](https://www.asendify.co/youtube/): Retention-focused long-form YouTube editing and channel growth.
- [Short-Form Editing](https://www.asendify.co/short-form/): Shorts, Reels and TikTok editing.
- [Trading & Finance Video Editing](https://www.asendify.co/trading/): Editing for stock market, crypto and personal finance YouTubers.
- [Podcast Editing](https://www.asendify.co/podcast/)
- [Talking Head Editing](https://www.asendify.co/talkinghead/)
- [2D Animation](https://www.asendify.co/animations/) and [3D Animation](https://www.asendify.co/3d/)
- [Comic-Style Explainers](https://www.asendify.co/explainer/)
- [Gaming Video Editing](https://www.asendify.co/gaming/)
- [Vlog Editing](https://www.asendify.co/vlogs/)
- [AI Video Content](https://www.asendify.co/ai/)
- [Clipping](https://www.asendify.co/clipping/)
- [AI Automations](https://morningstarr.asendify.co/)
- [Web Design](https://web.asendify.co/)

## Pricing (GBP; full terms on the Policies page)
- Elite Club agency retainer (YouTube growth and editing): from £10,000/month, unlimited edited videos made one at a time (fair-use limit 17,000 videos per onboarding); maximum 5 clients.
- Growth Plan: £600/month, unlimited edited videos made one at a time (fair-use limit 1,000 videos per onboarding).
- Book "Secrets to become a celebrity on Youtube": £217.50 one-time (£150 guide + £67.50 service fee).
- Retention Editing Accelerator: £997 one-time. 3-month YouTube Coaching: £3,000.
- A 45% service fee applies on top of every payment. One-time platform fee: a fixed £10,000 (+45% = £14,500). Other fees (documentation, payment processor, account management, processing) are listed in full on the Policies page.
- No deposit or payment is required to book a call; call fees are set out at https://www.asendify.co/policies/
